name: deputy
description: Manage Deputy workforce scheduling via the myHub-hosted Deputy MCP gateway — companies, departments, teams, employees, timesheets, shifts (roster), and leave requests. Browser OAuth through myHub — no API keys.

connection.instructions: Click Connect and sign in to your Deputy account. myHub handles the OAuth handshake and token refresh automatically — no API keys or manual token copying needed. You'll be asked to authorize access to your Deputy business during sign-in.
